record.notes: Two prices for two products. The tracker's EUR 3.00/month row is the vendor's own Minimal VPS group card, Mini I: 1 Core, 2 GB RAM, 30 GB SSD, 1.5 TB bandwidth, 1 Gbps, listed at EUR 8.99 with no billing period printed on the card and marked Out of Stock; EUR 8.99 / 3 months = EUR 2.99 per month (derived), matching the tracker's EUR 3.00 on quarterly billing. Linux I at EUR 4.99/month is out of stock at the cart and on the vendor's product page. No annual or renewal figure is printed on any page read.
